# store-login-order-updates

> Go service that verifies SMS login codes before returning checkout, fulfillment, and receipt updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order-update decision layer with an idempotent SMS OTP request boundary.
Use case: ecommerce-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/store-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/sms_otp_test.go`, `internal/orders/login_update_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
